gizmo.title: Mndandanda wa zochonga
gizmo.description: Mndandanda wa mabokosi ochonga. Owerenga amachonga zinthu ndipo kupita patsogolo kwawo kumakumbukiridwa pa chipangizo chawo.

configure.title: Mutu
configure.description: Dzina la mndandanda. Limawerengedwa mokweza ngati chilembo cha gulu la mabokosi ochonga.

configure.title: Zinthu
configure.description: Chinthu chilichonse ndi bokosi lochonga. Zinthu zochongedwa kapena zoletsedwa sizingasinthidwe ndi owerenga.

configure.title: Za manambala
configure.description: Onetsani mndandanda wa manambala m'malo mwa wa madontho.

configure.title: Momwe zilili
configure.description: Imasintha mitundu kuti ifanane ndi stop-note.

developer.title: ID yosungira
developer.description: ID yapadera yogwiritsidwa ntchito kukumbukira kupita patsogolo kwa owerenga pa chipangizo chawo. Imapangidwa yokha; isintheni kokha kuti mugawane kupita patsogolo pakati pa mindandanda kapena kuyambanso.
